note: Johnson County KS (20091) publishes its countywide parcel/property data only in the AIMS Property map service (maps.jocogov.org/ArcGIS/rest/services/Secure/Property/MapServer), which returns 'Token Required' and is restricted to AIMS data partners and subscribers. The public FreeData2 service and AIMS Free Data list have no parcel layer; parcel data is otherwise ordered via the paid Digital Data Request. Overland Park MixedInfo services cover only the city; Merriam parcel services are city-only. No public, unauthenticated county-wide parcel polygon service was found.
